title: Class 10 · Practice Test — Paper T2

question.text:
Butanone is a four-carbon compound with the functional group
(a) carboxylic acid (b) aldehyde (c) ketone (d) alcohol
Which term of the AP 21, 18, 15, … is −81?
List two methods of producing magnetic fields.

(a) What is meant by trophic level ?
(b) On an average, what percentage of energy is transferred to the second trophic level from the first trophic level ? Which categories of consumers do the organisms of the second trophic level belong to ?
Find the ratio in which the point P(−4, 6) divides the line segment joining the points A(−6, 10) and B(3, −8).
The far point of a myopic person is 80 cm in front of the eye. What is the nature and power of the lens required to correct the problem?

Pratyush took sulphur powder on a spatula and heated it. He collected the gas evolved by inverting a test tube over it.
(a) What will be the action of gas on (i) dry litmus paper? (ii) moist litmus paper?
(b) Write a balanced chemical equation for the reaction taking place.

The taxi fare in a city consists of a fixed charge together with a charge proportional to the distance covered. For a distance of 10 km, the charge paid is ₹105 and for a journey of 15 km, the charge paid is ₹155. Let the fixed charge be ₹x and the per-km charge be ₹y.
(i) Form the pair of linear equations.
(ii) Find the fixed charge and the per-km rate.
(iii) How much does a person have to pay for travelling 25 km?
